```{r}
# Read data/02_dat_clean.tsv
# Add derived variables (e.g. immunodominant flag, ORF groups, etc.)
# Save as data/03_dat_aug.tsv
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

Load data

```{r}
path = here("data", "02_data_clean.tsv")
combined_data_new <- read_tsv(file = path, show_col_types = FALSE)

combined_data_new
```

Create new columns

HLA-peptides (HLA-peptide combination)

```{r}
combined_data_new <- combined_data_new |>   
  mutate('HLA-peptide' = paste(HLA, Peptide, sep = "-")) 
combined_data_new
```

Identify response by log_fold_change and p-value

```{r}
combined_data_new <- combined_data_new |>   
  mutate(response = if_else((log_fold_change >= 2.0 & p < 0.05),1,0))

combined_data_new
```

Estimated Frequency (based on the authors:

-   count.1 / (sum of count.1 for Responses) \* multimer Frequency

```{r}
complete_data <- combined_data_new |>   
  group_by(sample)|>   
  mutate(ResponseCount = sum(count.1*response))|>
  ungroup()|>
  mutate(estimatedFrequency = case_when(ResponseCount == 0 ~ 0,       
                                        response == 1 ~ 
                                          (count.1 / ResponseCount)*MultimerFrequency,
                                        TRUE ~ 0))  
complete_data
```

```{r}
#total estimate frequencies to check if it is correct

complete_data <- complete_data |>
  group_by(sample)|>
  mutate(total_estimated_frequency = sum(estimatedFrequency)) |>
  ungroup()

complete_data
```

Write 03 file

```{r}
file_path <- here("data", "03_data_augment.tsv")

write_tsv(complete_data, file = file_path)
```
